headline: Bio-based and advanced materials in Europe are in a squeeze: weak pulp and fibre markets and cost inflation have pushed Finnish incumbents to cut textile-fibre projects and shift to packaging, while EU funding, policy and small Aalto-linked start-up rounds continue.
outlook_reason: Incumbent earnings are mixed and textile-fibre start-ups are under capital pressure, but EU funding calls, the Bioeconomy Strategy and steady seed rounds for Aalto-linked firms offset this.

metrics.value: EUR 161 million (+28 %); Biomaterials EUR 52 million vs 38 million

signals.title: LignoSphere (Aalto spin-off) extends pre-seed round with TekVentures
signals.detail: Espoo-based LignoSphere turns kraft lignin into colloidal particles for adhesives and coatings. Teknor Apex's TekVentures joined the round; Kiilto Ventures and Stephen Industries invested earlier in 2026; Business Finland provided a product-development loan until June 2027. External funding in 2026 totals just over EUR 1.2 million.

signals.title: Metsä Group Q3: earnings recover, comparable EBITDA EUR 100 million
signals.detail: Sales EUR 1,267 million; Jan–Sep comparable EBITDA EUR 357 million. Softwood pulp demand expected to stay subdued.

signals.title: Kemira Q3: revenue up on acquisitions, margins hit by raw-material costs
signals.detail: Revenue EUR 708.9 million, flat excluding acquisitions; FY2026 guidance kept.

signals.title: Spinnova shareholders approve dual-listing plan; US IPO not confirmed completed
signals.detail: Spinnova has publicly filed an F-1 targeting at least USD 15 million on Nasdaq Capital Market, and reported a EUR 1.5 million bridge financing in early October. I found no report that the IPO has priced or closed.

signals.title: Metsä cancels Kuura textile-fibre mill, invests about EUR 25 million in Muoto fibre packaging
signals.detail: Cancellation blamed on Asian overcapacity and low premium willingness. The Muoto line at Äänekoski starts in 2028.

companies.name: Stora Enso
companies.what: Forest-products group; opened a Cellufoam fibre-foam packaging pilot plant (Sept 2026) and works with Sulapac. Demerging its Swedish forest assets (H1 2027).

companies.name: UPM
companies.what: Forest and biochemicals group; its Leuna biorefinery in Germany makes wood-based chemicals (start date not verified).
